name: Grouper
tagline: One hub for a friend group or club: who owes what, who drives whom and the itinerary.
problem: Groups juggle payments, rides and plans across spreadsheets and chat apps.
solution: A group-centred web app with debt tracking and split bills, car assignments and an itinerary map.
demo_moment: Team-described: split a dinner bill and assign riders to cars for an outing.

why_it_stood_out.claim: A designer and a full-stack developer built it for their own group.

lessons: A problem the team lives every week gives a design prize an honest story.
